files.title: File:Morris Harris Farmstead Jefferson Co KS Residence south and east elevations.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Morris Harris Farmstead
The east façade of the house has a rusticated stone end chimney surmounted by a concrete cap. There are three wooden basement windows set in round arched masonry openings—two windows on the north side and one on the south side of the chimney.

files.title: File:Morris Harris Farmstead Jefferson Co KS Residence south facade.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Morris Harris Farmstead
The main residence faces south. The rectangular one-and-a-half story house is oriented east-west and consists of two sections with a small projecting rear bay.

files.title: File:Morris Harris Farmstead Jefferson Co KS Residence north and west elevations.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Morris Harris Farmstead
In the north façade, there are three basement windows set in round-arched masonry openings. One rear entrance is centered in the main block and another entrance faces east in the one-story projecting entry block at the corner.
